commit dd55c4127d51abf464f60fde5936c76cea6e57f8
Author:     Ben Campbell <benc@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Aug 6 06:06:23 2026 +0000
Commit:     benc@thunderbird.net <benc@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Aug 6 06:08:29 2026 +0000

    Bug 2061029 - Backed out changeset 5760699a44fe for causing failures.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D316719

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml
index d3a9881ee12..9637783f2de 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml
@@ -22,26 +22,6 @@ task-defaults:
 # mozilla-central for Firefox builds, except that the Android compiler-rt
 # pieces have been left out.
 
-linux64-clang-21:
-    description: "Clang 21 toolchain build"
-    attributes:
-        local-toolchain: true
-    treeherder:
-        symbol: TL(clang-21)
-    worker:
-        max-run-time: 600
-    run:
-        script: repack-clang.sh
-        toolchain-artifact: public/build/clang.tar.zst
-    fetches:
-        toolchain:
-            - linux64-cctools-port
-            - linux64-clang-21-raw
-            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
-            - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-21
-            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
-            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-21
-
 linux64-clang-22:
     description: "Clang 22 toolchain build"
     attributes:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
index 320af79f4df..e9091eaf265 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
@@ -11,13 +11,10 @@ kind-dependencies:
 
 reference-tasks:
     - linux64-7zz
-    - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
     - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
     - linux64-cargo-vet
     - linux64-cbindgen
     - linux64-cctools-port
-    - linux64-clang-21-profile
-    - linux64-clang-21-raw
     - linux64-clang-21-stage1
     - linux64-clang-22-profile
     - linux64-clang-22-raw
@@ -59,10 +56,8 @@ reference-tasks:
     - linux64-upx
     - linux64-winchecksec
     - linux64-wine
-    - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-21
     - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-22
     - linux64-xar
-    - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
     - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
     - macosx64-fix-stacks
     - macosx64-grcov
@@ -70,7 +65,6 @@ reference-tasks:
     - macosx64-node
     - macosx64-sdk
     - macosx64-sdk-toolchain
-    - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-21
     - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-22
     - mingw32-rust
     - node-modules
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
index 97aa9e451f3..642e8c53e47 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
@@ -51,7 +51,7 @@ macosx64-x64-libotr:
     fetches:
         toolchain:
             - linux64-cctools-port
-            - linux64-clang-21
+            - linux64-clang
             # Uses the SDK for builds, not the -toolchain SDK
             - macosx64-sdk
 
@@ -67,7 +67,7 @@ macosx64-aarch64-libotr:
     fetches:
         toolchain:
             - linux64-cctools-port
-            - linux64-clang-21
+            - linux64-clang
             - macosx64-sdk
